question: Who possesses eligibility in both life-stages during the Kali age?
premises: The context concerns conduct prescribed for the Kali age.
Eligibility is asserted in both āśramas.
This eligibility is attributed to all persons.
inference: All persons possess eligibility in both life-stages in the Kali age.
uncertainties: The precise identity of the two āśramas depends on the immediately preceding verses.
plain_english: O goddess, in both stages of life, everyone has eligibility.
